paths.name: react
paths.message: React Compiler memoizes the renderer (see apps/desktop/renderer/vite.config.ts). Write the plain value, function or component, and let the compiler cache it.

patterns.message: @letterbox/client runs in a browser renderer and in Hermes, which have no Node modules. Put code that needs Node in the transport that uses it, as packages/harness/src/client.ts does with its child process, and pass it in through the Transport type.

globals.name: process
globals.message: process is a Node global, and @letterbox/client must run unchanged in a browser renderer and in Hermes. Use what both have, such as Promise or setTimeout, or put the code that needs Node in the transport that uses it, as packages/harness/src/client.ts does, and pass it in through the Transport type.
